body:
What’s missing today is a high-quality discourse on rethinking the design and evolution of the entire system from scratch. (Otto Scharmer)

 Thankfully, there’s a lot of this kind of discourse going on at the Children, Youth, and a New Kind of Christianity conference in DC this week. I’m learning a lot and meeting amazing people from around the world.
